info.title: RSNA Knee 2.5D ConvNeXt reader
info.subtitle: Three fold checkpoints and code of an independently trained knee MRI reader
info.description:
Weights and code for the 2.5D ConvNeXt-Tiny reader used in the notebook 'RSNA Knee | Stack + 2.5D ConvNeXt MIL | LB 0.944'.

- `cnxt_v0_fold{0,1,2}.pt`: three of five cross-validation folds (EMA weights), trained on report-derived soft labels; the 58 official gold-labelled studies were not used for training.
- `preprocess.py`, `knee.py`, `infer.py`: inference code (DICOM series to canonical volume, model, prediction loop).
- `train.py`, `make_labels.py`, `oof.py`: training, label and scoring code, for reference.
- `pylibjpeg*.whl`: decoders for compressed DICOM, for offline install.

Public leaderboard: 0.929 alone (3 folds), 0.944 when rank-blended at 30% with the community stack.
